panels.description: The train climbs into Oasis: pearl-white architecture, reservoirs, geometric gardens and quiet transit. Keep the upper sky clear.
Ada scans her identity band at a polished clearance gate. Keep the upper gate clear.
Ada presses the largest rivet on her shoulder strap while the clearance display remains unresolved. Keep the upper display clear.
Alex looks toward the civic archive while Ada stands firmly beside him. Keep the upper concourse clear.

items.text: VEYRA, A. — RESIDENT RECORD FOUND — STATUS: UNRESOLVED.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: That’s a strange way to say hello.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: I chose to come this far.
